title: The Copper Joke
description: This Datapack makes silly changes to the new Copper Age Minecraft update.
body:
# ![# The Copper Joke](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6d174e84adc813b16655232376d7818b7d09ba84.png)
This is a datapack that adds joke features to go along with The Copper Age (1.21.9, works with pre release 2 and on). 

### Features Include:
- Struck enchantment for copper items
    * Put copper items in shelf, when struck by lightning items given struck
    * Gives armor +2 armor
    * Gives tools efficiency and more damage
    * Has unbreaking effect for all items
    * Exclusive with mending
    * Lightning gives effects based on how many items you have on
    * Shields and tridents can get effect as well
- Cross-copper
    * Recipe given once crossbow picked up
    * Hit entities are locked in copper blocks for a time based on how much health they have left
    * Breaking block deals damage and reduces trapped time
    * Works on players
- Wearable lightning rods
    * Give with the struck enchantment
- Attack golems
    * Giving copper golem copper ingot makes it attack golem for time based on copper amount
Goes around placing torches on enemies heads that deal damage until they die (maybe overpowered lol)
- Copper armor and tools
    * Random copper strikes when right click use on copper tools
    * When raining or thundering, copper items can get you struck with lightning
    * Can be hit onto other entities
- Dragon egg storm summoning
    * Place dragon egg on copper chest and stand on dragon egg
    * If copper chest has copper items in it, storm will be summoned that burns the copper items for fuel
- More specifics I haven't listed here lol
